div.head: Abt 21
div.ab: Gif man mannan ofslæhð, medume leodgeld C scillinga gebete.
Gif man mannan ofslæhð, medume leodgeld C scillinga gebete.
Gif man mannan ofslæhð, medume leodgeld C scillinga gebete.
Wenn einer jemanden erschlägt, büsse er [an dessen Sippe] mittleres Wergeld: 100 Schillinge.
If someone slays a person, let him pay [to his kin] a medium wergeld: 100 shillings.
If one man slays another, the ordinary wergeld to be paid as compensation shall be 100 shillings.
If anyone kills a man, he is to pay as an ordinary wergild 100 shillings.
If a person kills someone, let him pay an ordinary person-price, 100 shillings.

note.seg: Der Anfang lautet ganz wie beim anderen Satze vom typischen Totschlag am Gemeinfreien (wie 17¹), nämlich c. 30. Es liegt also keine Fortsetzung von c. 18ff. vor
The opening is worded exactly like that of the other clause on the typical homicide of a common freeman (as 17¹), namely c. 30. This is therefore not a continuation of c. 18ff.
Leudi heisst auch bei Festlandsgermanen ‘Wergeld’; Brunner I² 120
Leudi also means ‘wergild’ among the continental Germans; Brunner I² 120
